newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Deutsche to issue warrants on Brierley.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche to issue warrants on Brierley.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Friday it would issue warrants on Brierley Investments Ltd.
The warrants allow an investor to buy one ordinary share of Brierley Investments upon the exercise of two warrants and payment of NZ$1.50 per share at any time up to February 17, 1999.
"The Brierley warrant in the ninth warrant Deutsche Bank has launched in New Zealand," said Robert Gipslis of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities, global coordinator for the issue.
Deutsche Bank's other New Zealand warrants are over shares in Telecom, each of the Fletcher Challenge letter stocks, Carter Holt Harvey, Lion Nathan and units of the TeNZ fund.
The initial offering period will be from June 23 to June 27 and trading on the New Zealand Stock Exchange will commence on June 30. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
